'''April 2006 Syracuse tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament that [[Steve Jones]] announced for 2 p.m. on Saturday 22 April 2006 at How You Play the Game (formerly Altered States), as the next event in upstate New York.<ref name="pcf-9488-131501">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=131501#131501 next upstate local 4.22], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (10 April 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095904/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=135064&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> The store, formerly Altered States, is at 689 N. Clinton St., Syracuse, New York.<ref name="pcf-9928-136659">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=136659#136659 New York States 7.15], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618073001/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=137582&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' How You Play the Game (formerly Altered States), Syracuse, New York<ref name="pcf-9488-131501" /><ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />
* '''Dates:''' 22 April 2006<ref name="pcf-9488-131501" />
* '''Time:''' 2 p.m.<ref name="pcf-9488-131501" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Steve Jones]]<ref name="pcf-9488-131501" />

== Next event ==

On 2 May 2006 Jones gave 20 May 2006 as the date of the following upstate event; a ''Lord of the Rings'' Fellowship block event had also been booked at the store for that day.<ref name="pcf-9488-134717">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=134717#134717 next upstate local 4.22], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095904/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=135064&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>

== Results ==

No results were posted in the forum topic as captured on 18 June 2006.
